name: Control Freaks Hawaii Inc.
old_description: Control Freaks Hawaii is proud to serve residential and commercial clients throughout Kailua-Kona, Hilo, Waimea, and surrounding communities on the Big Island. Our team specializes in creating technology systems that integrate seamlessly into your space and remain reliable year-round.
about:
Control Freaks Hawaii Inc. operates from its headquarters at 52 Paa Street in Kahului, Hawaii, with a second location in Kurtistown on the Big Island. The company serves residential and commercial clients across the Hawaiian Islands, with a primary focus on Maui and additional coverage on the Big Island, Lanai, Molokai, Oahu, and Kauai. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The firm designs and installs integrated technology systems for homes and businesses. Its service portfolio includes smart home automation, multi-room music, home theater, lighting control, motorized window treatments, commercial automation, home security, and outdoor entertainment. Control Freaks Hawaii collaborates with builders, architects, and designers from the early design phase to embed lighting, shading, audio, and network plans into projects. The company offers consultation, personalized design, installation, and ongoing support packages, but does not manufacture hardware; it installs systems from brands such as Control4, Crestron, Lutron, Sonos, and Ketra.

Clients range from luxury homeowners and second-home owners to hospitality operators, condo associations, and trade professionals. The company explicitly mentions partnerships with hotels and spas, and its commercial automation work targets hospitality and condo automation systems. Builders, architects, and designers are engaged as trade partners through a referral program.

Control Freaks Hawaii emphasizes trust, craftsmanship, and local presence as differentiators. It holds Home Technology Association (HTA) certification, a third-party evaluation of technical qualification and client care, and maintains a Hawaii contractor license (CT-35828). The firm promotes personalized design, 24/7 support options, and fast service turnarounds rooted in community connections.
